'''Isan''' was a [[Maiden of the Spear]] of the [[Jarra (sept)|Jarra]] sept of the [[Chareen]] [[Aiel]]. 

== Activities ==
She died in the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]]

On the evening after the battle, [[Perrin Aybara]] comes across [[Rand al'Thor]] sitting alone. Rand is grieving and upset over the death of 151 Maidens in the battle. Perrin sits and listens as Rand begins reciting the names of all the Maidens killed; Isan's is the first name in the list.
